decision: Supersede the 07:30 execution clock before claim. Repair and validate only the generated retained-owner and claim-launch control flow, then pause claim-disabled for a fresh director binding.

observed_conflicts: repair_hold returns immediately after observing REPAIR_REQUEST.json, after which main releases maintenance without executing a repaired generation
a post-claim launcher exception before durable owner adoption has no exact-generation fallback release
OWNER_READY.json is written only after the 176172392-byte component and all other immutable files finish remote staging, while the detached launch call has a 30-second controller timeout

requirements: The owner must publish a fast owner-adopted readiness record only after validating the exact claim generation and starting its heartbeat, before any long transfer, image pull, compilation, or scientific work.
If claim-launch fails before durable owner adoption, the launcher must exact-generation release the claim. After durable adoption, the launcher may return only while the recorded owner remains live.

The owner must be a multi-generation state machine: each recoverable pre-decision failure emits generation-indexed decision evidence, remains heartbeating, consumes an exact-generation repair request, and actually re-enters the failed phase without changing immutable science.

A repair request must never cause immediate release. Deadline, heartbeat-loss, success, and unrepaired failure paths must each perform one expected-claimed-at generation-fenced release and persist its result.
The active-session record must distinguish owner adoption from immutable staging and scientific-runner entry.
offline_fault_injection: delayed staging longer than 30 seconds leaves one live adopted owner and no launcher-created orphan
failure before owner adoption releases exactly the claimed generation
one recoverable failure plus one matching repair request executes generation 1 under the same claim
no repair request reaches the bounded deadline and releases maintenance
a complete typed component terminal releases ready exactly once
repair_contract.terminal_write_rule: Write last and atomically only after Python compilation and all five deterministic fault injections pass.

budget.note: A later execution binding must recompute cumulative attributed exposure and leave terminal plus generation-fenced release margin before this budget deadline.

prohibitions: Do not SSH, invoke CUDA, transfer the component, pull the image, compile on H200, or run any scientific sample.
Do not alter immutable source, runner, component, shapes, repetitions, oracle, image, or acceptance gates.
Do not inspect or run R5 endpoint science.
Do not mutate provider lifecycle or watchdog.
